result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is a prominent visual artifact in the bottom navigation and some horizontally clipped content that may reduce clarity.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar appears across the bottom navigation, overlapping the search icon and extending unusually far across the screen. It looks like a broken indicator, scrollbar, or rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar or replace it with a properly sized tab-selection indicator that does not overlap navigation icons.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partially visible category chip and truncated restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: If these are intentional horizontal carousels, add a clearer overflow cue and ensure clipping is deliberate; otherwise constrain the content to the viewport or adjust card widths.

issues.description: The bottom navigation is very close to the screen edge, with some icon elements appearing visually cramped or partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate bottom safe-area padding and verify the navigation height across device sizes.
